def VTask.strongDownwardInduction {α : Type u_1} {p : Finset α → Sort u_4} {n : ℕ}
  (H : (t₁ : Finset α) → ({t₂ : Finset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ ⊂ t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁)
  (s : Finset α) (h : s.card ≤ n) : p s :=
  WellFounded.fix (measure (λ s => n - s.card)) (fun s self =>
    H s
      (λ {t₂} h_t₂_le_n h_subset =>
        self t₂
          (Nat.sub_lt_sub_right n t₂.card s.card h_subset.card_lt h_t₂_le_n))
      h)
  s
